masks: All 216 immutable C0 masks, all three regimes, 5/10/20/40/60/80 percent nominal coverage, three mask replicates; realized coverage and geometry always retained
primary: Frozen C0 two training, one validation, one primary test patient. Test observed anchors are permitted sparse inputs; hidden primary labels only score final predictions. Prior C0-C4 results were known.
sensitivity: Four conditional held-out patients; S2-50/S2-280, 10/20/40 percent, all three regimes and all three mask seeds. Train B4 and image PCA on the other three patients, retain primary-selected interpolation/fusion/regularization settings. Reuse frozen C4 fold-specific B1 predictions. Not unbiased cross-validation.
B0: Mean of permitted training anchors from each training slide's frozen random 60 percent replicate-0 mask. Never a held-out or hidden-label mean.
B1: Equal average of all three frozen C4 selected local MLP seeds; reuse saved primary/fold held-out predictions. For C5 training/validation locations without saved predictions, read-only inference through the frozen C4 heads. No previous fit is rerun or retuned.

B3.formula: lambda * frozen image prediction + (1-lambda) * validation-selected stronger B2 family

selection: Per panel and geometry, choose k and power by mean validation hidden-location MSE across all coverages and mask replicates (equal mask weights). Choose the stronger B2 family likewise. Choose lambda separately by encoder/panel/geometry using the same validation-only mean MSE. No test selection.

B4.description: Compact two-hop linear graph propagation with learned per-gene residual heads over B3. Node inputs contain image PCA, observed indicator and zero-filled observed expression. Frozen C2 kNN6-cap250 graph. Features include local/one-hop/two-hop image PCA, observed indicator/masses, nearest-anchor distance, B1, B3, own observed expression, and normalized one/two-hop observed-expression messages. Hidden own-expression inputs are exactly zero. No cross-gene hidden inputs.
B4.selection: One alpha per encoder/panel by mean validation MSE across all masks, after B2/B3 choices are established. Same grid and deterministic fitting for both encoders. No learned fusion head beyond this compact propagation family.
B4.loss: Only training-patient hidden expression is supervised main loss, separated from feature construction. It never enters molecular inputs, scaling, retrieval or auxiliary targets. No held-out main-loss labels. No auxiliary losses.
B4.scaling: Frozen C0 target units, no new expression-derived scaler. Image-only standardization/PCA fit on training H&E. Graph molecular messages use only observed anchors and observed-indicator normalization.

negative_controls.mask: primary test random nominal 20 percent replicate 0
negative_controls.NC1: Permute observed vectors among observed positions
negative_controls.NC2: Permute positions assigned to intact observed vectors; equivalent association-null family, not an independent biological mechanism
negative_controls.NC3: Permute image features and frozen image predictions among locations; molecular anchors fixed
negative_controls.scope: NC1/NC2 for B2a/B2b/B3/B4, NC3 for B1/B3/B4, both encoders where applicable. No retuning.

leakage: Predictor accepts only image/coordinate scene plus observed-only anchor payload. Each final run checks NaN and random corruption of all hidden genes before payload extraction; compare both predictions exactly with uncorrupted predictions. Observed/hidden barcode lists and mask checksum are stored in every prediction.
metrics: Hidden locations only; per-gene Pearson/Spearman/MSE/MAE; panel mean/median and Pearson fractions. Fixed C0 normalized units. Constant prediction correlation undefined, never recoded as zero in stored metrics.
fidelity: No validated scalar fidelity cutoff, horizon or minimum gene coverage is claimed. Report continuous distance curves and full gene-by-coverage matrix.
figures: Predeclared map: TENX99, all three regimes, 20 percent replicate 0, first frozen S2-50 gene, ResNet18 B3. Fixed examples, no score-based selection.

gate.sparse_setting: At least 2 of 3 masks: B2 selected over B1 has panel median Pearson gain >=0.02 and mean MSE reduction >=2percent
gate.fusion_setting: Across three masks, median gene-paired B3-minus-B2 Pearson gain >=0.01, mean MSE nonincrease, and max(3,ceil(5percent panel)) genes with mean Pearson gain >=0.05, positive gain in >=2 masks, non-increasing mean MSE
gate.patient_support: Same encoder/panel/geometry has a qualifying fusion setting and a sparse setting in at least two of four conditional patients at 10/20/40percent
gate.contiguous_ability: Same encoder/panel in at least one contiguous geometry: B3 median Pearson >=0.20 and MSE <=0.9*B0 in >=2 masks, both primary and >=2 conditional patients
gate.coherence: For selected B2 random masks, increasing coverage correlates positively with median Pearson and negatively with MSE in at least two of three primary panels, using Spearman across mask-averaged realized coverages
gate.PASS: At least one panel/encoder has >=2 primary sparse settings and >=2 primary fusion settings, each counted across nominal coverage/geometry, patient support, contiguous ability, coherence, complete distance diagnostics and integrity pass
gate.MIXED: No PASS, but at least one primary sparse setting or at least one qualifying fusion setting exists
gate.TECHNICAL: Any hidden-label invariance, order, model replay, parent hash, mask or input-identity audit failure

B4_gain_rule: Descriptive only: B4 over B3 mean MSE nonincrease and median gene-paired Pearson gain >=0.01 across three masks, with positive mask gain in >=2 masks and support in >=2 conditional patients. No complexity escalation if absent.
recommendation: PASS with >=10percent relative random B2 MSE change between lowest/highest coverage -> PROCEED_TO_SAMPLING_OPTIMIZATION; other PASS -> PROCEED_TO_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION; MIXED/FAIL -> NEED_SPARSE_ST_REVIEW; technical failure -> STOP_TECHNICAL. Recommendations only; stop after C5.
